stages.headline: Short multiplication formulas: (a ± b)² = a² ± 2ab + b², a² − b² = (a − b)(a + b), a³ − b³ = (a − b)(a² + ab + b²).

stages.headline: Powers: aᵐ · aⁿ = aᵐ⁺ⁿ, (aᵐ)ⁿ = aᵐⁿ, a⁻ⁿ = 1/aⁿ, a^(m/n) = ⁿ√aᵐ.
